title: Attach a vCenter to VCF Automation exactly once on a re-run
prompt:
A VCF 9.1 onboarding runbook attaches vCenter servers to VCF Automation. The runbook is re-run whenever a step times out, and the last re-run registered the same vCenter a second time. Attach Virtual Center is a mutating call and the API offers no idempotency key, no client-supplied request id and no conditional create, so the client has to make the call safe to retry itself.

Implement a stdlib-only Java client in the single source file `VcfAutomationVirtualCenterClient.java` (no build tool, no third-party libraries, no JSON library). Provide exactly this public API:

- `new VcfAutomationVirtualCenterClient(String baseUrl, String jwtToken, String tenantOrgId)` where `tenantOrgId` may be null or blank to mean no organization context.
- `AttachOutcome ensureVirtualCenterAttached(String name, String url, String username, String password, String description, Boolean isEnabled)`
- nested `public record AttachOutcome(boolean alreadyAttached, String vcId, String taskLocation)`
- nested `public static final class VcfAutomationApiException extends RuntimeException` with `statusCode()` and `minorErrorCode()` accessors.

Read the protected `docs/contract.json` first. It pins the two operations in scope, Query Virtual Centers and Attach Virtual Center, and its `exercise_profile` pins the exact wire shape you must produce: header set, query-parameter order and percent-encoding, JSON property order and the omission rule. `docs/official_sources.json` records the Broadcom xAPIs reference page behind every field, the operation each page documents and the date it was fetched; VCF Automation publishes no machine-readable specification, so the contract is transcribed from reference documentation and is the authority here. Call no other route.

`ensureVirtualCenterAttached` must:

- Reject a null or blank `name`, `url`, `username` or `password` before touching the network, and reject a null or blank `baseUrl` or `jwtToken` in the constructor.
- Issue exactly one Query Virtual Centers request, filtered on the vCenter `url`, before any mutation.
- Return `alreadyAttached=true` with the `vcId` the API reported and a null `taskLocation` when that url is already attached, without issuing the POST at all. Identity is the `url`, not the name. More than one entry for the same url is an inconsistent inventory: throw `IllegalStateException` and mutate nothing.
- Otherwise issue exactly one Attach Virtual Center request and return `alreadyAttached=false`, a null `vcId` and the task URI taken from the `Location` header of the 202 response. A 202 without a Location header, or a 200 page without a `values` array, is an `IllegalStateException`.
- Send `description` only when it is non-blank and `isEnabled` only when it is non-null. An unset optional field is omitted from the request body, never sent as null, an empty string, an empty object or a placeholder, and no other `VCenterServer` property is ever sent. Send the tenant-context header only when an organization id was supplied.
- Escape JSON string values correctly and put non-ASCII characters on the wire as UTF-8, not as `\u` escapes.
- Turn a non-successful response into `VcfAutomationApiException` carrying the HTTP status and, when the response has an `Error` body, its `minorErrorCode` and `message`. Never put the password or the JWT into an exception message.

The fixture in `MockVcfAutomation.java` serves those two operations on loopback and nothing else, and it holds real state: an accepted attach becomes visible to the next query, and attaching an already attached url is rejected. Its request log is what the verification reads. No live VMware endpoint or credential is involved.

Run `java TestMain.java` (JDK 22 or later). `TestMain.java`, `MockVcfAutomation.java` and `docs/**` are protected and must not be changed.

prerequisites.java: 22 or later, for the multi-file source-code launcher

source_basis.reason: VCF Automation has no specification document in VMware's Apache-2.0 vmware/vcf-api-specs repository, so no specification path or commit SHA could be pinned.
source_basis.api_reference: Provider Infrastructure APIs (VCF Automation Provider Management), version 9.1

scenario: a re-run of an onboarding runbook must attach a vCenter server through VCF Automation without registering it twice, so the client queries the collection filtered on the vCenter url before it posts and skips the mutating call when that url is already attached
constraint: the contract-pinned loopback request log proves the exact request wire shape: one query before any mutation, no second POST on the retry, the versioned Accept header and tenant-context header rules, the pinned query-parameter and JSON property order, and omission of every unset optional field
